one_line: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO amid relationship revelations, while OpenAI launched agent shopping and security tools.

themes.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
themes.text: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned after admitting to relationships with a subordinate and a woman identified as a Chinese spy. CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO while the board approaches Arm CEO Rene Haas and faces congressional and financial fallout.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns following revelations about personal relationships
Nvidia approaches Arm CEO Haas as employees seek Huang's return
Report details past clash between Jensen Huang and interim CEO Colette Kress
Wall Street fears Jensen Huang's ouster will slow Nvidia's AI dealmaking
Start-up investors and founders worry about losing ally in Jensen Huang
Congressional Democrats launch inquiry into Nvidia China chip sales and Trump deal
Jensen Huang misled Nvidia leaders about relationship with Alice Huang

themes.title: AI infrastructure financing and debt concerns
themes.text: Cloud provider Nscale disclosed a net loss of $1.69 billion and $5.5 billion in debt as it seeks extra funding after a $45 billion Anthropic contract. Meanwhile, ReNew Energy Global pledged ₹80,000 crore for green data centers in Andhra Pradesh, and NITI Aayog warned of capital concentration risks.

stories.headline: Nscale says it needs extra funding for 2027 commitments after $45B Anthropic chip order
Nscale reports $5.5B in debt and $1.69B loss in amended IPO filing
ReNew pledges ₹80,000 cr for green data centre and manufacturing in Andhra Pradesh
Niti Aayog's Debjani Ghosh warns AI risk lies in capital and power concentration

themes.title: AI agents expand shopping and calling features
themes.text: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet for AI agent shopping, while Amazon drafted the World Product Graph to index global product data for AI search. Meta also added outbound calling features to its consumer AI agent Muse.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI agent shopping
Amazon plans World Product Graph to index global product data for AI agents
Meta launches outbound calling for Muse to paid U.S. subscribers

themes.title: OpenAI updates security and robotics teams
themes.text: OpenAI launched Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security products and disbanded its standalone robotics team as general models take over. Elsewhere, researchers used Claude to analyze Kurt Gödel's notebooks, revealing hundreds of proved theorems.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches Daybreak Red Team and Defense Factory security products
OpenAI disbands standalone robotics team as general models take over
AI unlocks Kurt Gödel's notebooks to reveal hundreds of proved theorems
